title: Architecture analysis: Remove per-phase/task breakdown delegation from implement phase
summary: Collapse all conditional execution paths in the implement phase to always use concurrent BRC execution. Remove Tier 3 phase-level dispatch, multi-agent wave execution, single-agent fallback, short-circuit mode, complexity tiers, integrator role, and all associated plumbing. ~5000-6000 lines removed across ~25-30 files. Dependency on #1164 (coordinator removal) is satisfied — PR #1169 merged. Recommended approach: single PR with four ordered phases. Revision 2 fixes the file path error flagged in plan review, addresses INTEGRATOR enum values in checkpoint/types modules, and adds missing test files to the update list.
revision_notes: Revision 2 addresses plan review feedback (verdict: needs_revision). Three changes: (1) Fixed TASK-2-3/2-4/2-5 file path from non-existent orchestrator/orchestrator.py to actual orchestrator/routes/pipelines.py. (2) Added explicit handling for INTEGRATOR enum values in shared/egg_orchestrator/types.py, shared/egg_contracts/checkpoints.py, shared/egg_contracts/models.py (AgentRole enum, separate from INTEGRATOR_ROLE), gateway/checkpoint_handler.py, and orchestrator/models.py. (3) Added 9 missing test files to the update scope in TASK-4-2.

problem_statement.description: The implement phase has accumulated multiple conditional execution paths: Tier 3 phase-level dispatch (_run_tier3_implement), multi-agent wave execution (_run_multi_agent_phase), single-agent fallback, short-circuit mode, and complexity tiers. The decision tree in orchestrator/routes/pipelines.py (line ~6446) selects between these paths based on multi_agent, complexity_tier, and concurrent_execution flags. This branching logic is hard to reason about, test, and maintain, and different paths produce inconsistent behavior.

root_causes.title: Multiple parallel execution models coexist
root_causes.description: Four execution paths exist: concurrent BRC (_run_concurrent_phase at line 4563), Tier 3 phase-level dispatch (_run_tier3_implement at line 3640), multi-agent wave execution (_run_multi_agent_phase at line 4359), and single-agent fallback (line 6598). The decision tree at line 6446 uses priority ordering: concurrent > tier3 > multi_agent > single-agent.

root_causes.title: Short-circuit mode adds conditional plan-phase skip logic
root_causes.description: _check_short_circuit_signal (line 1656) reads short_circuit: true from refine draft YAML to skip the plan phase. This threads a short_circuit parameter through ~10 call sites in _build_phase_prompt (lines 2566-2856) and affects phase progression logic (lines 7392, 7633, 7658).

root_causes.title: Complexity tiers drive Tier 3 eligibility and gateway behavior
root_causes.description: ComplexityTier enum (models.py:233) with LOW/MID/HIGH drives dispatch selection. HIGH triggers Tier 3. The tier value threads through container_spawner.py, gateway_client.py, agent_restrictions.py (INTEGRATOR_TIER3_PATTERNS), phase_filter.py, and session_manager.py.

root_causes.title: Integrator role only used by Tier 3 dispatch
root_causes.description: The INTEGRATOR role is spawned as the final pass in _run_tier3_implement. It has dedicated gateway patterns (INTEGRATOR_TIER3_PATTERNS in agent_restrictions.py:325-359), sandbox artifacts (integrator.md, integrator-mode.md), and reviewer dependency entries (REVIEWER_CODE and REVIEWER_CONTRACT depend on INTEGRATOR in agent_roles.py:483, 515). With Tier 3 removed, the role has no purpose.

dispatch_decision_tree.description: Priority-ordered dispatch: (1) if is_concurrent_execution() → _run_concurrent_phase(), (2) if complexity_tier==HIGH and multi_agent → _run_tier3_implement(), (3) if multi_agent → _run_multi_agent_phase(), (4) else → single-agent _spawn_and_wait(). Coordinator branch already removed by PR #1169.

conditionals.use_concurrent: is_concurrent_execution(pipeline, phase) — checks pipeline.config.concurrent_execution or phase in concurrent_phases
conditionals.use_tier3: current_phase == 'implement' AND complexity_tier == HIGH AND multi_agent

concurrent_brc.description: Spawns all agents simultaneously via ConcurrentPhaseExecutor. Consensus-driven polling. This is the KEEPER.

tier3_dispatch.description: Loads contract phases, builds PhaseDependencyGraph, iterates phases in dependency order running CODER → TESTER → DOCUMENTER → CHECKER → REVIEWER_CODE per phase. Final INTEGRATOR pass. Falls back to _run_multi_agent_phase if no phases.

multi_agent_wave.description: Uses MultiAgentExecutor for wave-based execution. Gets roles from get_roles_for_phase(), creates PipelineDispatcher, builds per-role prompts.

single_agent_fallback.description: Builds phase prompt, spawns lone CODER agent via _spawn_and_wait(). No contract/dispatcher involvement.

multi_agent_py.description: MultiAgentExecutor class, AgentWave class, wave orchestration. Also hosts is_concurrent_execution() at lines 653-673 which must be relocated before deletion.

dispatch_py.description: PipelineDispatcher wrapping egg_contracts.Orchestrator. create_dispatcher() factory. map_agent_role_to_contract_role() mapping. signals.py imports create_dispatcher (line 35) — must be inlined first.

dependency_graph.description: PhaseDependencyGraph class (line 382) and PhaseWave class (line 364). Only used by _run_tier3_implement.

integrator_enum_decision.description: The plan review noted that INTEGRATOR enum values appear in 5 modules beyond agent_roles.py. This section clarifies the removal/retention decision for each.

remove.reason: Orchestrator AgentRole enum — no agents will be spawned with this role. Remove to prevent dead enum value from confusing future maintainers.
Contract AgentRole enum — used for multi-agent config roles_enabled list. MultiAgentConfig itself is being removed (E1). Remove.
Orchestrator types AgentRole enum — used by sandbox egg-orch CLI and message bus. No agents will have this role. Remove.
Agent role definitions AgentRole enum — the primary definition. Being removed as part of INTEGRATOR_ROLE removal.

keep.reason: Checkpoint AgentType enum is used to classify stored checkpoint data. Historical integrator checkpoints exist in the egg/checkpoints/v2 branch. Removing would break deserialization of these records. Keep the enum value but it will not be assigned to new agents.

This mapping resolves orchestrator role names to checkpoint AgentType for checkpoint storage. Since AgentType.INTEGRATOR is retained for backward compat, this mapping must also be retained to correctly handle any remaining checkpoint writes or reads.

recommended_approach.strategy: Single PR with four ordered implementation phases
recommended_approach.rationale: Pipeline constraint requires a single PR. The work is organized into four internal phases: (1) prerequisite relocations and refactors, (2) core orchestrator removal, (3) configuration, gateway, and role cleanup, and (4) documentation and test cleanup. This matches the analysis recommendation's migration order.

critical_file_path_correction.description: TASK-2-3, TASK-2-4, and TASK-2-5 in the plan reference orchestrator/orchestrator.py which DOES NOT EXIST. The actual file is orchestrator/routes/pipelines.py (8004 lines). All functions listed in these tasks (_run_tier3_implement, _build_phase_scoped_prompt, _run_multi_agent_phase, _check_short_circuit_signal, _check_high_complexity_signal, single-agent fallback, decision tree) are in orchestrator/routes/pipelines.py.

migration_order.description: Relocate is_concurrent_execution() from multi_agent.py to concurrent_executor.py. Refactor signals.py to inline dispatch calls. Remove integrator from reviewer deps and role maps.

Delete multi_agent.py, dispatch.py. Remove execution paths from orchestrator/routes/pipelines.py: _run_tier3_implement, _run_multi_agent_phase, single-agent fallback. Collapse decision tree to always-BRC. Remove short-circuit mode and complexity tier detection.
migration_order.rationale: Central change — eliminates all alternate execution paths

migration_order.description: Remove integrator role (definition, enum values in 4 modules, gateway patterns, sandbox artifacts). Remove MultiAgentConfig. Remove gateway complexity_tier threading. Remove dead config flags. Remove DAG visualizer tier3 code. Remove PhaseDependencyGraph/PhaseWave.
Delete 9 dead test files. Update 15 surviving test files (6 original + 9 newly identified with INTEGRATOR references). Update documentation (10 files). Final verification grep.

recommended_approach.validation: All remaining tests pass. Concurrent BRC execution works end-to-end for all phases.
